entries.012094cd903a046c: In the breakdown of revenue from contracts with customers by prefecture, for the fiscal year ended February 2026 Hiroshima Prefecture accounted for 16.9%, Ehime Prefecture for 16.7% and Hyogo Prefecture for 16.5%, followed by Okayama Prefecture at 12.9% and Kagawa Prefecture at 12.4%. The number of stores is largest in Hyogo Prefecture with 92, Ehime Prefecture with 89 and Hiroshima Prefecture with 81. To improve store convenience, the company newly introduced self-checkout at 9 stores, bringing the cumulative total to 379 stores, and introduced electronic shelf labels at 120 stores, bringing the cumulative total to 210 stores. The granting and use of WAON POINT also began at all stores.
entries.0a5ffabed718208a: Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥784,256 million (up 0.7% year on year). By segment, the General Retail Business was ¥745,604 million (up 0.8% year on year) and Other Related Businesses was ¥38,652 million (down 0.9% year on year). Management's analysis gives the year-on-year change in revenue as up 0.6% for the supermarket format, up 2.3% for the discount store format and up 8.0% for mobile supermarkets. In addition, there is real estate rental income and other operating income, which are printed separately and not included in revenue.

The filing's "Description of Business" lists the company and the consolidated subsidiaries Fuji Mart Co., Ltd., Fuji Mart Shikoku Co., Ltd. and Nichiei Co., Ltd. in this business. Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥745,604 million (up 0.8% from the previous fiscal year), accounting for the majority of consolidated revenue. Management's discussion and analysis describes the year-on-year change in revenue as up 0.6% for the supermarket format, up 2.3% for the discount store format and up 8.0% for mobile supermarkets.

entries.889f6194da2ce9c8: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥8,176 million (up 114.1% year on year). Management's analysis attributes this to the sale of investment securities, the transfer of shares in an equity-method affiliate, and a decrease in income tax adjustments resulting from the recording of impairment losses. Net income for the previous fiscal year was ¥3,818 million. Aggressive wage increases, growth investments such as revitalization of existing stores and scrap & build, and soaring logistics costs are cited as factors that pushed up expenses.

entries.f6d8ae951e73a3f4: This is a business that transports goods by vehicle and sells them to people who have difficulty shopping. Management's analysis states that in the fiscal year ended February 2026 it began operating new routes at seven stores, bringing the cumulative total to 94 stores, 146 vehicles and 798 routes. Revenue for this format rose 8.0% year on year. The amount is not separately printed in the securities report.
entries.f8771adf1ca064c9: These are supermarket stores selling mainly food and also daily necessities. Management's analysis states that in the fiscal year ended February 2026 it focused mainly on revitalizing existing stores through renovations, strengthened sales of EDLP (Every Day Low Price) products such as "Zenryoku Price" and "Mainichi ga Yasui", and expanded Top Value products. Revenue for this format rose 0.6% year on year. The amount is not separately printed in the securities report.
entries.fbd92c98826f1e1e: These are stores that emphasize low prices. Management's analysis states that it expanded the range of DS-dedicated private-brand products of the AEON Group and lowered costs by using the DS distribution center. In the fiscal year ended February 2026, seven stores were revitalized and one store was scrapped and rebuilt. Revenue for this format rose 2.3% year on year. The amount is not separately printed in the securities report.
entries.fd2d7417574805e5: A retail company whose parent is [[company:aeon|AEON CO.,LTD.]]. According to the Description of Business in the annual securities report, as of February 28, 2026, the consolidated group consists of the company, 20 subsidiaries and 2 affiliates, and carries out lifestyle-proposal business activities centered on general retail. The number of consolidated employees is 7,757 (the average annual number of hourly-paid employees, shown separately, is 24,971). The medium-term management plan for fiscal years 2024-2026 sets out as basic strategies the establishment of corporate culture, reform of existing businesses, integration of business infrastructure and creation of synergies, and promotion of ESG management.
entries.fd4c0a8686c84d3f: These are businesses run by group companies around the retail business. The annual securities report's 【Business Description】 section lists food and beverage, electronic money, fitness clubs, wholesale of fruit, vegetables and marine products, real estate leasing, building maintenance, travel and nursing care services. Net sales for the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥38,652 million (down 0.9% year on year). Revenue by business is not shown in the annual securities report.
